transcript.text: Hello everyone. Thank you for being here. As the Memorial Coordinator, I'm putting together the memorial plan for the family's grandmother, and I'd like to hear from each of you before we settle on the details. The family has expressed that they value hearing one another's needs and relevant updates before plans for gatherings are finalized. So please, share whatever information or concerns you have, and we'll work together to make sure this brief lakeside memorial is done right.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Everyone, I have something important to share. I have Grandma's handwritten note. In it she says, 'Please let me rest at Willow Point,' and she asks the family to use the dedication words 'Love keeps finding its way home.' I think this should guide our plans for the memorial.

commitments.detail: Ensure the group uses the north paved trail to reach Willow Point so Ruth can safely attend without navigating stairs or steep slopes.
Schedule the memorial to begin at 10:00 on the planned Saturday so the ashes can be placed at Willow Point within the county's permitted 10:00–12:00 window.
Arrange for the ashes to be transferred from the temporary plastic container into a water-soluble urn before the ceremony.
Include Grandma's requested dedication words, 'Love keeps finding its way home,' in the short dedication at the ceremony.
